svg.title: OpenE2EE horizontal lockup — light
svg.desc: The OpenE2EE symbol beside the wordmark, centered on each other vertically.
svg.metadata: Lockup: horizontal; mode: light; symbol height 128; wordmark cap height 79.36; generated by @open-e2ee/design 0.9.1. Set in Public Sans; the wordmark is live text and needs the family available.
